question: Estimate the number of customer support agents needed for a large Indian fintech app (e.g., PhonePe / Paytm).
idealClarificationQuestions: Active user base assumed: ~250M MAU? Yes.
All channels: voice, chat, email? Yes.
Average support ticket volume per user per month? Industry knowledge.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Tickets per month / agent productivity = headcount needed.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Monthly support contact rate (transactions × failure rate × user-reach-out rate): ~1-1.5% of MAU contact support per month = 2.5-3.75M tickets/month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average resolution time: 8-10 mins per ticket (mix of FAQ chatbot deflected, simple chat, escalated voice).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Agents needed (24×7 coverage with 3 shifts): 100K daily / 40 tickets = ~2,500 active agents per shift × 3 shifts = ~7,500 agents.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 8-10 mins per ticket (mix of FAQ chatbot deflected, simple chat, escalated voice).
100K daily / 40 tickets = ~2,500 active agents per shift × 3 shifts = ~7,500 agents.

calculationFlow: Monthly support contact rate (transactions × failure rate × user-reach-out rate): ~1-1.5% of MAU contact support per month = 2.5-3.75M tickets/month.
Tickets per agent per day: 6 × 60 / 9 = ~40 tickets.
Agents needed (24×7 coverage with 3 shifts): 100K daily / 40 tickets = ~2,500 active agents per shift × 3 shifts = ~7,500 agents.
